about: Every object the owner's painting (hall.jpg, 1344 x 896) shows, with the box it fills there, [x0, y0, x1, y1] in the painting's pixels, and the names of the pieces of the house that are that thing (src/house/inventory.js). Read off the painting by eye, by Claude, on 11 October 2026. tools/house/inventory.mjs renders the hall from the painting's camera and holds each to its box. `fill`, where given, is the share of the box the thing must cover instead, for things that are not boxes in the frame (the runner, the ceiling's joists).

items.what: a flat white enamel shade on a cord, bulb showing under it
heavy dark joists across the ceiling
a small-paned window in the left wall, the night behind it
a pale cloth hung over the top of the window
a large woven bag on crossed straps, hung on the back wall
a small hard chair against the back wall, under the bag
a low dark cabinet with a drawer and a panelled door, in the left corner
a round-faced clock on the cabinet
a green vase on the cabinet, by the window
a chest in the near left corner with a white cloth over it
a tall dark door in a heavy frame, two panels filled with upright planks
a small dark fitting on the back wall beside the parlour door
a round-headed arch onto the passage
a door down the passage, on its left
something small lying on the floor in front of the arch
a steep dark flight of stairs up the right-hand side, to the ceiling
a handrail on square balusters down the open side of the stairs
a heavy square newel post at the foot of the banister
a tall narrow framed picture on the right-hand wall
the front door in the right-hand wall: two lights of glass over a lock rail, upright boards below, in a deep frame
a paper notice pinned to the right-hand wall by the front door
a patterned runner down the middle of the floor
